voltage_check.description: 磁航向电压检查：额定电压24V±2V

current_check.description: 磁航向电流检查：最大电流5A

magnetic_sensor_check.rule: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM uav_magnetic_metrics WHERE device_id='${device_id}' AND magnetic_x >= -1000 AND magnetic_x <= 1000 AND magnetic_y >= -1000 AND magnetic_y <= 1000 AND ts >= ${start_time} AND ts <= ${end_time}
magnetic_sensor_check.description: 磁传感器数据检查：X/Y轴在正常范围内

temperature_check.description: 拷机1温度检查：最高温度85°C

power_check.rule: SELECT AVG(power) as avg_power FROM uav_power_metrics WHERE device_id='${device_id}' AND ts >= ${start_time} AND ts <= ${end_time} HAVING avg_power <= 240
power_check.description: 拷机1功率检查：平均功率不超过240W

position_check.description: 桁架位置检查：X/Y轴在正常范围内

load_check.rule: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM uav_load_metrics WHERE device_id='${device_id}' AND load_weight >= 0 AND load_weight <= 100 AND ts >= ${start_time} AND ts <= ${end_time}
load_check.description: 上料台负载检查：负载重量在0-100kg范围内

basic_voltage_check.description: 默认电压检查：最低电压20V

basic_current_check.description: 默认电流检查：最大电流15A

basic_status_check.description: 默认状态检查：状态不为error

tdengine_templates.avg_range_check: SELECT AVG(${field}) as avg_value FROM ${table} WHERE device_id='${device_id}' AND ts >= ${start_time} AND ts <= ${end_time} HAVING avg_value >= ${min} AND avg_value <= ${max}
tdengine_templates.max_check: SELECT MAX(${field}) as max_value FROM ${table} WHERE device_id='${device_id}' AND ts >= ${start_time} AND ts <= ${end_time} HAVING max_value <= ${limit}
tdengine_templates.count_check: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM ${table} WHERE device_id='${device_id}' AND ${field} ${operator} ${value} AND ts >= ${start_time} AND ts <= ${end_time} HAVING count >= ${min_count}
